info.title: Meteroid API v2
info.description: The public REST API v2. A request may send `Meteroid-Version: YYYY-MM-DD` to pin a version (the first, 2026-12-01, by default) and `X-Request-Id`; every response echoes the version it was served at and its `Request-Id`. These headers are documented once (`components.parameters`, `components.headers`), on no operation: an SDK sends them itself. A POST other than a preview takes an `Idempotency-Key`: a retry with the same key and request replays the first response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`), or an `IdempotentReplayMarker` naming the resource's `id` when the first response was not kept (larger than 512 KB, or holding a secret). Its `x-idempotency` says whether the key is `required` (the writes that can invoice, credit or record money refuse a request without one, `400 idempotency_key_required`) or `optional`. A PATCH takes `application/json` and `application/merge-patch+json` alike: one whose body is a JSON merge patch (RFC 7396: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it) declares `application/merge-patch+json`, the one whose body lists changes (`PATCH /rate-cards/{id_or_code}/rates`) `application/json`. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`application/problem+json`) with a specific `code`; `403 forbidden` refuses the credentials, `403 feature_not_available` a feature the organization's plan or edition does not include. A `401` carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`. A response the request rate limit counted carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` (Unix seconds), and the IETF draft's `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit`; its `429` adds `Retry-After` (seconds). Enums in responses are open: new values (problem and field error codes, event types, statuses) may appear without a new `Meteroid-Version`, and a client must accept a value it does not know (a problem by its HTTP status, a field error as `invalid`). Lists are paged by cursor, `?limit=&after=`, as their `x-pagination` describes. Prices and rates are decimal strings in the currency's major unit; amounts billed are integers in minor units.

post.description:
Ingests usage events for metering and billing, 1 to 500 a request (the body 1 MB at most).
An event names its `customer` by Meteroid id or as `ext:<alias>`; its `properties` are
strings, numbers or booleans, which metering keeps as text (`1048576`, `true`). Its
`timestamp` (RFC 3339, the time it is received when left out) is between 24 hours ago and
1 hour from now, or up to 13 months ago with `allow_backfilling`.

Events are deduplicated by `(event_id, customer)`: re-sending the same pair is not counted
twice. The first copy received is kept and later copies are ignored, whatever they change.

By default one rejected event refuses the whole batch: the answer is `422
validation_failed`, each rejected event in `errors` at its pointer (`/events/3`,
`/events/3/customer`); sending the batch again once fixed is safe. With
`allow_partial_failures`, the accepted events are ingested and the `200` names the rejected
ones in `rejected`. Metering names a rejected event by its `event_id` only: an `event_id`
sent twice in one batch is matched to its copies in the batch's order.

checkout_url.description: Where the customer pays, while it waits for them.

currency.description: The money it is paid in.

oneOf.description: The invoice documenting the purchase.

TopUpCollection.description:
How a top-up is paid: `charge` a saved payment method now, or `send_invoice` and grant the
credit once it is paid.

free.description: Nothing is billed during the trial.

plan.description: The plan the trial gives access to, by code (id or code on input); none: this plan.

ends_on.description: When it ended or ends; read on a single subscription.

free.description: Nothing is billed during it; read on a single subscription.

UnattributedMetricUsage.description: A stretch of a metric's usage no subscription bills.

subscriptions.description: The subscriptions pricing the metric then, whose usage filters leave it out.

UnattributedUsage.description: A customer's usage over `[from, to)` that no subscription bills.

UnitConversion.description: Usage divided by `factor` (tokens priced per 1M: 1000000), then each period's total rounded.

UnitPrice.description: The price this customer agreed for one credit of a unit, in major units of `currency`.

UpdateAddOn.description: A merge patch. `prices` replaces every price of the charge; how it bills never changes.

entitlements.description: Replaces what it grants; `[]` grants nothing.

UpdateCoupon.description:
A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it. The code, the redemption
limit and `reusable` never change; `discount` replaces the discount whole (it cannot switch
between promotional credit and an invoice discount).

oneOf.description: `forever` or `months`; past redemptions keep theirs.

UpdateCreditNote.description: A JSON merge patch of a credit note: its custom properties.

custom_properties.description:
Merged into the note's: a key sent `null` is removed. Validated against the tenant's credit
note custom property definitions.

UpdateCreditUnit.description:
A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it. In `prices`, a currency set
replaces its price (the previous one is kept for what pinned it) and `null` stops selling the
unit in that currency; currencies left out keep theirs.

prices.description: The prices to set, by currency; `null` archives a currency's price.

UpdateCustomer.description:
A JSON merge patch of a customer (RFC 7396): a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it,
an object (an address, `tax`, `invoicing`, `custom_properties`) is merged field by field, a
list is replaced. Every field of the customer as written may be sent.

custom_properties.description: Merged by key: `null` removes a property.

UpdateFeature.description: A merge patch; the code, the type and the product never change.

oneOf.description: `null` removes the default.

options.description: A `select`'s values; one still granted cannot be removed.

UpdateInvoice.description:
A JSON merge patch of an invoice: its custom properties at any status; its lines, memo,
purchase order and due date while it is a draft.

custom_properties.description:
Merged into the invoice's: a key sent `null` is removed. Validated against the tenant's
invoice custom property definitions.

due_date.description: A draft's; `null`: its net terms from the day it is issued.

lines.description:
A draft's lines, all of them (a list replaces): a line kept is named by its `id`, a line
left out is removed, a line without an `id` is added. The draft then finalizes from these
lines as written, no longer priced again from the usage.

UpdateManagedQuantity.description: A merge patch; the code never changes.

UpdateMetric.description: A merge patch. The code, event code, aggregation, group, family and product never change.

unit_singular.description: Sent with `unit_plural`; both `null` remove the unit.

UpdatePlan.description:
A merge patch of the live fields; versions are written through the draft, the status by
`…/archive` and `…/unarchive`.

UpdateProduct.description: A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it.

entitlements.description:
Sets the default of each of its features named; one of its features left out loses its
default. Features are made with their product (`POST /features`).

UpdateRateCard.description: A merge patch of what a card may change: its name and what unmatched usage does.

UpdateSubscription.description: A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it.

custom_properties.description:
Merged into the subscription's, validated against the tenant's custom property
definitions.

end_date.description:
The day it stops renewing and completes; `null`: it renews until cancelled. Only what is
not billed yet moves: a date after today that cuts no period already billed (a date inside
one is a cancellation on that date: `POST …/cancel`). Refused while a cancellation is
scheduled, or a change on or after the date.

external_id.description: The integrator's own id, unique per tenant; `null` clears it.

UpdateWallet.description:
A merge patch of a wallet's settings: a field left out is unchanged. `null` clears the
thresholds, turns automatic top-up off (removing its terms) and returns the customer to the
unit's list price; an `auto_top_up` object replaces the terms whole.

unit_price.description: Credit unit wallets: a decimal string, in major units of the customer's currency.

UpdateWebhookEndpoint.description:
A merge patch: a field left out is unchanged, `null` clears it; `event_types` and `headers`
replace the lists. Enabling an endpoint again resets its failure count.

api_version.description: Pins its payloads to another published version (`2026-12-01`); it cannot be removed.

UsageAmount.description: An amount in minor units of its currency, or of its credit unit for usage priced in credit.

oneOf.description: The credit unit; what credit leaves uncovered is invoiced in money, not counted here.

UsageAtZero.description:
What a customer's usage does once the credit it can use runs out: what each subscription's
plan says, or always or never stop, for this customer.

UsageCosts.description:
A metric's usage and cost per bucket over `[from, to)`, cut at UTC boundaries, within the
billing periods pricing it.

oneOf.description:
Per-unit prices and rates by dimension only: absent for prices depending on the whole
period's usage, and for a metric whose unit conversion rounds.

id.description: The id the event was ingested with.

quantity.description:
The billed units it adds; absent when the aggregation cannot be split per event, or the
event does not count.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

UsageFilter.description:
Restricts the customer's usage events the subscription bills to those whose `property` is
`value` (an API key, a project); one without bills the customer's events no other
subscription's filter takes.

effective_from.description: When it started to apply: the start of the usage not invoiced yet when it was set.

UsageGroup.description: The usage of one group of a metric's dimensions.

computed_at.description:
Beta, on a subscription's current period only: when `costs` and `totals` were computed;
the reading is shared for up to 30 seconds.

totals.description: Beta: the metrics' costs added up, per currency or credit unit.

VatNumberStatus.description: The VIES check of the VAT number: pending, valid, invalid, or VIES could not answer.

add_on.description: By code (id or code on input).

VolumeModel.description: Every unit priced by the tier the total reaches.

Wallet.description:
A customer's credit in one currency or credit unit. The customer's own currency is always
listed, even empty.

balance.description:
`credit_on_account` less the part of `unbilled_usage` credit will pay; never negative.
Absent until the customer's usage was priced once.

credit_on_account.description:
Credit granted, in effect, not applied to an invoice nor expired; usage not invoiced yet is
not deducted (see `balance`).

oneOf.description: The credit unit; absent for a currency.

credit_unit_precision.description: Decimal places of `credit_unit`: amounts are integers of 10^-precision credit.

currency.description: Absent for a credit unit wallet.

low_balance_thresholds.description: Balances sending `wallet.balance_low` once crossed downward; ascending, at most 5.

pauses_at_zero.description: Usage stops once the credit is used up, for one active subscription at least.

subscription_credit.description: The part of `credit_on_account` only one subscription can use, per subscription.

unbilled_usage.description: Usage priced but not invoiced yet, tax included.

oneOf.description: A credit unit wallet: the customer's agreed price per credit; the list price when absent.

upcoming_credit.description: Credit granted that takes effect later.

usage_only_credit.description: The part of `credit_on_account` that pays only usage charges.

WalletList.description: Every wallet of the customer, one per currency or credit unit: a list never paged.

WebhookDelivery.description: One event queued for one endpoint.

last_response_status.description: The HTTP status of the last answer.

manual.description: Made by a resend or a test event.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

WebhookEndpoint.description: Where Meteroid POSTs the signed payloads of the events it subscribes to.

api_version.description:
The API version its payloads are pinned to: the `Meteroid-Version` it was created at.
Payloads are v1's today, whatever it says; once v2 payloads ship, an endpoint receives
them in its version's shape. Absent on an endpoint created through v1 or the dashboard,
which keeps v1's payloads.

archived_at.description: Set by `POST …/archive`, read only in its answer: an archived endpoint is no longer read.

consecutive_failures.description: Failures since the last success; 0 again on any 2xx.

event_types.description:
The event types it receives, as a payload's `type` names them (`invoice.paid`). Empty:
every event type but the beta ones, sent only to endpoints naming them.

max_in_flight.description: Deliveries in flight at once, at most; set from the tenant's environment.

needs_setup.description: A sensitive header waits for its value: the endpoint cannot be enabled before.

paused_until.description:
Unreachable several times in a row: nothing is sent before then, then one delivery at a
time until it answers.

rate_limit_per_sec.description: Deliveries started per second, at most.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

WebhookHeader.description:
A header sent with every delivery. A sensitive one never reads its value back: `set` says
whether it has one.

WebhookHeaderInput.description:
A header to send with every delivery. A sensitive one is write-only; in a patch, one sent
without a value keeps the value it has.

WebhookSecret.description: The secret deliveries are signed with.

When.description:
When a change takes effect. Which a change accepts is checked in one place (`when.rs`): a plan
change, an amendment or a level move take effect now or at the period's end, a downgrade of
plan or level at the period's end only; a cancellation also on a date.

id.description:
The user's id (`usr_…`) for USER, the customer's (`cus_…`) for CUSTOMER, the API key's
or app's for API_KEY and OAUTH_APP; absent for SYSTEM.

type.description: USER, CUSTOMER, API_KEY, OAUTH_APP or SYSTEM.

V1CouponCreditScope.description: Which subscriptions a promotional credit coupon's credit pays.

duration_months.description:
Applies to billing periods starting within this many months of the first paid period;
neither this nor `recurring_value`: forever.

recurring_value.description: Invoices it discounts on a subscription, for coupons made before `duration_months`.

CreditAppliesTo.description: Which charges credit pays: ALL pays any part of an invoice, USAGE only its usage charges.

V1CreditDiscount.description:
Promotional credit added to the customer's credit balance when the subscription the coupon is
redeemed on starts. It never discounts an invoice and applies before tax. A customer redeems
it at most once, so the coupon cannot be `reusable`. Its code is case-insensitive: it is stored
upper-case and redeemed whatever the case.

amount.description: Credit added per redemption, in major units (e.g. "25.00").

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; it must match the currency of the subscription the coupon is redeemed on.

expires_in_days.description: Days the credit stays spendable after redemption, 1 to 3660. Absent: it never expires.

scope.description:
CUSTOMER (default): the credit pays any of the customer's subscriptions. SUBSCRIPTION: the
credit pays only the subscription the code is redeemed on, and ends with it.

CreditGrantExpiredEventData.description:
A credit grant expired, or the subscription it belongs to ended, with credit left, which
lapsed.

applicable_product_ids.description: The products whose charges the grant pays; empty when it pays every product.

applies_to.description: What the grant pays: ALL any charge, USAGE only usage charges.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit (its code) the amounts are in; absent for a currency.

credit_unit_precision.description: Decimal places of `credit_unit`: amounts are integers of 10^-precision credit.

currency.description: Absent when the amounts are in a credit unit.

expired_amount.description: Unspent credit that lapsed, in minor units of `currency` or `credit_unit`.

expired_at.description: When the grant expired, or its subscription ended.

ledger_entry_id.description: The credit ledger entry recording the expiry.

reason.description:
SUBSCRIPTION_ENDED when the subscription the grant belongs to ended at or before the grant's
expiry, EXPIRED otherwise.

subscription_id.description:
The subscription the grant belongs to: it pays only that subscription's charges. Null when
it pays any of the customer's subscriptions.

CreditGrantLapseReason.description: Why a credit grant's unspent credit lapsed.

CreditGrantType.description:
PAID credit was bought, through Meteroid or outside it, and applies after tax like a payment.
PROMOTIONAL credit was given (included with a plan, a coupon, bonus credit, a goodwill grant):
it applies before tax, like a discount, so it is spent before paid credit. Credit-unit grants
are drawn together, whatever their type.

credit_note_number.description: Absent while the credit note is a draft — the number is assigned at finalization.

custom_properties.description: User-defined custom property values, keyed by definition key.

invoice_number.description: Number of the invoice being credited.

tax_breakdown.description: Per-rate tax (VAT) breakdown for the credited amount.

CustomerEvent.description: Event-specific webhook schemas for type-safe webhook payloads

custom_properties.description: User-defined custom property values, keyed by definition key.

DeclineKind.description: Why the payment provider declined a charge.

EInvoicingFinding.description: One rule the document did not satisfy, in the standard's own vocabulary.

term.description: The business term path it is about — "BG-8/BT-55".

V1EInvoicingStatus.title: EInvoicingStatus
V1EInvoicingStatus.description:
Whether the structured e-invoice was produced with the accounting PDF. Absent when the
invoicing entity had not opted in at the time the invoice was issued.

InvoiceDocumentsEventData.description:
Emitted once the accounting PDF is stored. This is also the moment the e-invoicing
outcome is known: the structured document is produced with the PDF, not at finalization.

einvoicing_error.description: Set when generation failed for a reason that is not a business rule.

einvoicing_profile.description: The profile the document was checked against, e.g. "EN 16931".

oneOf.description: Absent when the invoicing entity had not opted in.

xml_document_id.description: The structured e-invoice stored beside the PDF, when one was produced.

oneOf.description: Set on `invoice.consolidated`: the parent invoice this one was merged into.

custom_properties.description: User-defined custom property values, keyed by definition key.

invoice_number.description: Absent while the invoice is a draft — the number is assigned at finalization.

oneOf.description:
Set on a corrective invoice: the cancelled invoice this one replaces
("cancels and replaces"). The original is credited in full by a credit note.

settled_by_credit_notes.description:
On `invoice.paid`: true when finalized credit notes, not a payment, settled the invoice's
whole total. Nothing was collected, so it books no cash. False on every other event.

InvoiceLineCreditUnit.description:
How a usage line priced in a credit unit was paid: the credits it consumed, those the
customer's balance in the unit covered, and the rate the rest was billed at.

covered.description: Of which paid by the customer's credit wallet.

precision.description: Credit amounts are integers in 10^-precision credit.

oneOf.description:
Usage priced in a credit unit. The line's money amounts then only carry the credits the
customer's balance in that unit did not cover, billed at `rate`.

quoted_unit_price.description:
The tax-included unit price the customer was quoted, on a line billed from
tax-inclusive prices. `unit_price` is its net counterpart.

oneOf.description:
The line broken down by its metric's `usage_breakdown_key`: each value's quantity and its
part of the line's amount. Together they add up to the line's quantity and amount.

items.description: Largest amount first. Past 99 values, the rest are summed in one last item flagged `others`.

key.description: The event property the usage is broken down by, e.g. `project_id`.

amount_subtotal.description: Its part of the line's amount before discounts and tax, in minor units.

credits_consumed.description: Its part of `credit_unit.consumed`, on a line priced in a credit unit.

others.description: Set on the last item when there are more than 99 values: it sums the rest.

quantity.description: Usage of this value, in the units the line is priced in.

quoted_amount_subtotal.description: Its part of the tax-included amount quoted, on a line billed from tax-inclusive prices.

value.description: The property's value; absent for events without it, and for `others`.

unit_plural.description: What several units of the metric are called, e.g. `tokens`.

unit_singular.description: What one unit of the metric is called, e.g. `token`.

oneOf.description: Unset: a product's charges own how it is billed.

RefundEventData.description:
A refund row, or the payment that failed or was clawed back — the same shape the REST invoice
exposes as a transaction. `reversal_reason` is deliberately absent: it is free provider text and is
not carried on the outbox event.

amount_disputed.description: The part of `amount_reversed` lost to disputes or chargebacks: the invoice stays paid.

amount_reversed_excess.description:
What the provider withdrew above what the payment still held (refunded before); never
applied to the invoice or credit. Contest it with the provider.

RefundMode.description:
How a voluntary refund was issued: through the provider, or recorded after a wire or cash
movement made outside Meteroid.

V1ReversalKind.description: Why a payment was involuntarily clawed back.

cancellation_reason.description: Present on `subscription.cancelled` when a reason was supplied.

oneOf.description: Present on `subscription.updated`: which mutation fired the event.

custom_properties.description: User-defined custom property values, keyed by definition key.

SubscriptionStatusEnum.title: SubscriptionStatus
SubscriptionStatusEnum.description:
`PendingCharge`, `Paused`, `Suspended`, `Superseded` and `Errored` stay in the published
schema; no subscription holds them any more, and a filter on them lists none.

SubscriptionUpdateType.description: Identifies which mutation triggered a `subscription.updated` webhook.

exemption_reason.description: Free-text legal exemption mention (EU exempt/reverse-charge invoices).

tax_reference.description: Accounting/reporting code of the tax rate for this line, for exports.

WalletCreditRecoveredEventData.description: Spent credit reported by `wallet.credit_unrecovered` is backed again.

cause.description:
Cause of the loss this recovers: `PAYMENT_DISPUTED`, `PAYMENT_REVERSED`,
`PAYMENT_REFUNDED` or `CREDIT_NOTE_REFUNDED`.

oneOf.description: The refund credit note behind the loss; absent for a reversed payment.

credit_recovered.description:
Spent credit an earlier `wallet.credit_unrecovered` reported that is backed again, in
minor units: the money came back, or the credit was returned and taken back.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit (its code) the amounts are in; absent for a currency.

credit_unit_precision.description: Decimal places of `credit_unit`: amounts are integers of 10^-precision credit.

credit_unrecovered_total.description:
The loss of this money flow (an invoice's payments, a credit note, or a payment) once
this event applies.

currency.description: Absent when the amounts are in a credit unit.

oneOf.description: The invoice whose money bought the credit; absent for a payment no invoice took.

The payment whose reinstatement recovered it, if one did; always set when `invoice_id`
is absent.

WalletCreditUnrecoveredEventData.description: Purchased credit was already spent when its money came back.

cause.description:
`PAYMENT_DISPUTED` (lost to a dispute or chargeback), `PAYMENT_REVERSED` (a failed
collection clawed back), `PAYMENT_REFUNDED` (a payment refunded without a credit note, at
the provider or as an overpayment, after the credit it backed was spent) or
`CREDIT_NOTE_REFUNDED`.

oneOf.description: The refund credit note that caused the loss; absent for a reversed payment.

credit_taken_back.description: Unspent credit taken back from the wallet at the same time, in minor units.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit (its code) the amounts are in; absent for a currency.

credit_unit_precision.description: Decimal places of `credit_unit`: amounts are integers of 10^-precision credit.

credit_unrecovered.description:
Spent credit this event adds to the loss, in minor units. A failed collection reopens its
invoice, which collects it again; a dispute's loss stays unless the dispute is won.
`wallet.credit_recovered` reports what comes back.

credit_unrecovered_total.description:
The loss of this money flow (an invoice's payments, a credit note, or a payment) once
this event applies.

currency.description: Absent when the amounts are in a credit unit.

oneOf.description:
The invoice whose money bought the credit; absent for a payment no invoice took (a
plan-change payment kept as credit).

The payment whose reversal or reinstatement moved the loss; always set when `invoice_id`
is absent.

Who removed the credit by hand. Absent when an invoice, a credit note or a reversed
payment moved it.

applicable_product_ids.description: The products whose charges the grant pays; empty when it pays every product.

applies_to.description: What the grant pays: ALL any charge, USAGE only usage charges.

oneOf.description: The credit note that took the credit back.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit (its code) the amounts are in; absent for a currency.

credit_unit_precision.description: Decimal places of `credit_unit`: amounts are integers of 10^-precision credit.

currency.description: Absent when the amounts are in a credit unit.

oneOf.description: The invoice the credit was applied to.

ledger_entry_id.description: The credit ledger entry recording the movement.

reason.description: Why the credit moved, as shown on the ledger.

subscription_id.description:
The subscription the grant belongs to: it pays only that subscription's charges. Null when
it pays any of the customer's subscriptions.

applicable_product_ids.description: The products whose charges the grant pays; empty when it pays every product.

applies_to.description: What the grant pays: ALL any charge, USAGE only usage charges.

oneOf.description: The credit note that gave the credit back.

credit_unit.description: The credit unit (its code) the amounts are in; absent for a currency.

credit_unit_precision.description: Decimal places of `credit_unit`: amounts are integers of 10^-precision credit.

currency.description: Absent when the amounts are in a credit unit.

grant_type.description: PAID or PROMOTIONAL: whether the credit applies after or before tax.

oneOf.description: The invoice that bought the credit, or whose void gave it back.

ledger_entry_id.description: The credit ledger entry recording the movement.

subscription_id.description:
The subscription the grant belongs to: it pays only that subscription's charges. Null when
it pays any of the customer's subscriptions.

BadRequest.description: The request could not be read: a malformed body or parameter, or an unsupported `Meteroid-Version`.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, unknown or revoked.

WWW-Authenticate.description: `Bearer`: the API key is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: retry later, with the same `Idempotency-Key` for a POST.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Sent when the request rate refused the request; a limit counted within a request (events per second, usage cost reads, event corrections) says its wait in `detail`.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the bucket holds when full.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the bucket: `0` on a refusal.

RateLimit-Reset.description: The Unix time, in seconds, the bucket is full again.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The bucket as the IETF httpapi draft's structured field: `"<policy>";q=<requests>;w=<window seconds>`.

RateLimit.description: What is left of it as the draft's structured field: `"<policy>";r=<requests left>;t=<seconds until full>`.

Meteroid-Version.name: Meteroid-Version
Meteroid-Version.description: The API version to serve, as a date: the latest version published on or before it. The first, 2026-12-01, when left out; a date before it, or not a date, is refused (`400 unsupported_version`). Published: 2026-12-01.

Idempotency-Key.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency-Key.description: Taken by a POST whose `x-idempotency` is `required` or `optional`, kept 24 hours; a `required` one is refused without it (`400 idempotency_key_required`). Only a POST takes one: a PATCH, a PUT and a DELETE are sent again as they are. A retry with the same key and request replays the first response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`), or an `IdempotentReplayMarker` (its `x-replay-marker`) when the first response was not kept; the same key with another request is refused (`422 idempotency_key_reused`), and while the first still runs (`409 idempotency_request_in_progress`).

X-Request-Id.name: X-Request-Id
X-Request-Id.description: Your id of the request, up to 128 visible ASCII characters: answered as `Request-Id` and in a problem's `request_id`. One is generated when left out.

Meteroid-Version.description: The version the request was served at.

Request-Id.description: The id of the request: the `X-Request-Id` sent, else a generated one. Quote it to support.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` on the replay of the first response to a request with the same `Idempotency-Key`: its status and body, or an `IdempotentReplayMarker` when the first response was not kept (read the resource by its `id`).

tags.name: Add-ons
tags.description: A charge sold beside a plan.

tags.name: Checkout sessions
tags.description: A hosted checkout of a plan: the customer pays on its page, which creates the subscription.

tags.name: Coupons
tags.description: Discounts and promotional credit redeemed by code: what they take off, for how long, with which plans and add-ons, and who may redeem them.

tags.name: Credit notes
tags.description: What an invoice gives back: to the customer's balance, in money, or as debt cancelled.

tags.name: Credit units
tags.description: Denominations usage is priced and credit granted in instead of money, each with its selling price per currency.

tags.name: Custom properties
tags.description: The properties a tenant defines on its customers, subscriptions, invoices, credit notes and quotes, which their `custom_properties` are checked against.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Who is billed: named by id or by alias (`ext:<alias>`), with their addresses, tax and invoicing settings and portal token, and what is theirs under the customer's path: entitlements, credit per currency or credit unit (wallets, grants, the ledger, top-ups), usage, and budgets in the Enterprise edition.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Usage events, ingested for metering and billing: 1 to 500 a request, each naming its `customer` by id or `ext:<alias>`, its properties strings, numbers or booleans.

tags.name: Features
tags.description: What a customer may use (a flag, a usage cap, a setting), granted by plan versions, add-ons and products.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: What a customer is billed: drafts priced as usage comes in, then issued, paid, voided or written off.

tags.name: Managed quantities
tags.description: Counts a subscription holds and changes (seats), shared by the charges naming them.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: What usage is measured by: the usage events of an event code, aggregated. Several metrics may read one event code, each its own way.

tags.name: Plans
tags.description: A plan is a price sheet: versions of charges in options, written through a draft and published.

tags.name: Pricing pages
tags.description: A product family's pricing page, priced in one currency and option.

tags.name: Product families
tags.description: The product lines a catalog is sorted in, each with its pricing page.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: What is sold. How it is billed is each charge's.

tags.name: Rate cards
tags.description: Dated rates of a metric's usage by its dimensions, and their history.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: A customer on a plan: its seats, levels, charges and add-ons, changed now or at the period's end, each change previewed first; its entitlements and usage.

tags.name: Usage
tags.description: The tenant's usage by metric. A customer's and a subscription's are under their own paths.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Endpoints Meteroid POSTs signed event payloads to, their signing secret, and their deliveries. The payloads (this document's `webhooks`) are rendered in API v1's shapes, their schemas as v1 names them (`V1<Name>` where v2 has a schema of that name): v1's field names and enum spellings, not v2's. An endpoint's `api_version` will pin its payloads' shape when v2 payloads ship.
